This week · 本周目标

Hello again!

先复习熟悉的内容，再进入 Level 2：人物与家庭称呼、数字 1–10、字母、颜色、年龄、位置词，以及用完整句子回答 Who's he/she? 和 Where's …?。

Review familiar language at a stronger Level 2 pace, with short reading, spelling, listening and speaking tasks.

Sounds & spelling

Key language

Who's he? He's Simon.
Who's she? She's Stella.
This is my brother, Simon. He's seven.
This is my sister, Suzy. She's four.
Where's the white whale? It's on the wheel.

Parent routine · 家长安排

周一至周五每天约 15–20 分钟。让孩子自己读一部分、听一部分、说一部分。周四或周五完成 2–3 个录音。周五可把 Tracker 截图发给老师。

15–20 minutes Monday–Friday. Mix reading, listening, speaking and a small amount of writing. Finish 2–3 useful recordings and the Tracker by Friday.

15–20 minutes a day
